title: HEALPix on both

dataset.name: DKRZ EERIE future ssp245, P1M mean, HEALPix level 7 (Zarr; from gridlook's shipped catalog)

left.label: warp: rangefinder (HEALPix via lib/dggs.js: view pixels to cell ids, inverse sampling)
left.note: Provisional permalink (variable, day and stretch not yet recorded). rangefinder reads HEALPix since Oct 2026 by inverting the view: each output pixel centre to lon/lat to cell id (healpix-geo) to a chunk index; no mesh.

right.label: cell: gridlook
right.note: Loaded through gridlook.pages.dev until the vendored build is confirmed to reach this host from the sidebyside origin.

gap: Both sides draw a HEALPix field by different routes: gridlook builds a cell mesh on the sphere, rangefinder inverts the view and samples the chunk. Before Oct 2026 the warp side refused the store ("no 1D coordinate arrays for cell / time"); the refusal is kept in docs/rangefinder-healpix.md as the record of the gap. The remaining asymmetry is on the analysis side: trend.sst's S2 cells have no renderer on either side.
bridge: S2 as a second cellsOf in rangefinder's v.dggs object (the shape was built for this), with a trend.sst Parquet as the fixture; and a HEALPix-to-tile-scheme recipe so ortho-cog-viewer and rwarp can see cells too.
